$comment: Gzipped KB budgets enforced by scripts/check-bundle-budget.mjs in CI.
These are RATCHETS set just above today's measurement, not aspirational targets.
A budget you are already failing is a budget everyone learns to ignore. Lower them
as TD-004 (code splitting) lands; the target for largest-js-chunk is 250.
'current' is the last measured value, refreshed with --update. It exists so the
report can show a delta: growth that stays under budget is still worth seeing.

largest-js-chunk.label: Largest single JS chunk
largest-js-chunk.why: The metric that decides time-to-interactive. One blocking chunk is the problem, not the total.

total-css.label: Total CSS
total-css.why: Currently 0 because Tailwind is compiled in-browser from a CDN (TD-007). Expect ~15-30 KB once it moves into the build.
